difficulty_reason: The lemma produces a modification of the base ring along an affine blowup after which a given finite module becomes flat, and the proof is a 75-line construction. It writes the ring as a quotient of a polynomial ring, chooses a presentation of the module, and then changes the presentation by adding the equations of the blowup so that the relations become the ones whose minors control flatness; the verification that the resulting module is flat uses the Fitting ideal criterion for flatness of a finite module and the explicit form of the blowup equations. The construction of the new presentation and the flatness check are both carried out in the source.
